themes.title: Quantum Machine Learning
themes.summary: Machine-learning frameworks for quantum state classification and discrimination, hybrid quantum–classical neural networks built from variational quantum circuits, hybrid quantum–classical vision models, and quantum-assisted reinforcement learning.

themes.title: Variational Algorithms & Quantum Optimization
themes.summary: Variational quantum circuits on IBM Quantum backends for hybrid quantum–classical optimization, including VQE- and QUBO-based formulations for network scheduling, traffic routing, EV charging scheduling, and other NP-hard decision problems in next-generation intelligent networks.

themes.title: Quantum Communication & Networks
themes.summary: Protocols and channel models for reliable and privacy-preserving quantum networks: controlled quantum semantic communication for industrial cyber-physical systems, full-duplex anonymous communication in adversarial quantum networks, and MIMO quantum communication over correlated pure-loss channels.

themes.title: Quantum Control & Hardware
themes.summary: Reinforcement-learning-based quantum control and pulse-level gate design: quantum optimal control with pulses, deep reinforcement learning for pulse shaping in single-photon emitters, RL-based NISQ state preparation, quantum reservoir learning for Rydberg-lattice control, and Purcell-filter design for superconducting circuits.

themes.title: Error Mitigation & NISQ Computing
themes.summary: Error mitigation for noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices: measurement and readout error mitigation, adaptive readout error mitigation with transfer learning, and machine-learning-based qubit state estimation on IBM Quantum hardware.
